meta.name: web-design-guidelines
meta.description: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance. Use when asked to "review my UI", "check accessibility", "audit design", "review UX", or "check my site against best practices".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页界面代码,确保符合设计规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要确认网页界面是否遵循通用设计规范与无障碍要求。
copy.tagline_en: Ensure your UI code meets web design and accessibility standards.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to verify your web interface follows common design and accessibility guidelines.

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求审查界面等时，Claude 会先从指定网址获取最新版 Web 界面指南，读取用户指定的代码文件，逐条核对指南中的所有规则，最后以“文件路径:行号”的简洁格式列出不合规项。若用户未指定文件，会先询问审查对象。
howto.when: 当用户提出“review my UI”“check accessibility”等审查请求，或要求按最佳实践检查网站时触发；未指定文件时会先询问要审查哪些文件。

say.text: 审查 src/App.js 的 UI 代码
say.note: 拉取最新指南并检查该文件

say.text: 检查我的界面可访问性和最佳实践
say.note: 输出 file:line 格式的不合规项

say.text: 审计 design 相关代码，给出不合规行号
say.note: 未指定文件时会先询问要审查哪些文件

howto.what_en: Fetches the latest Web Interface Guidelines, reads the given code files, checks them against all rules, and reports findings as file:line. If no files are specified, prompts user for files.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests like "review my UI", "check accessibility", etc., or asks to check the site against best practices. Prompts for files if none given.

say_en.text: Review the UI code in src/App.js
say_en.note: Fetches latest guidelines and checks that file

say_en.text: Check my interface accessibility and best practices
Audit design-related code and report non-compliant lines
say_en.note: If no file is given, asks what to review
